name: Tools
vision_statement: The AI acts only through tools the person's authority allows.
opportunities: Tools differ in what they can change and how it can be undone, so each category the person allows is reached through its own measured solution and the person's authority bounds it all.
solution_coherence: Tools lets the assistant act only through what the person's authority allows. Delegated Agent Sessions runs a goal in a headless agent within a turn and cost bound. Detect A Stalled Run reads a run's live activity to tell a stuck run from a slow one. File Editing changes files inside one folder and keeps each change reversible. Quest Change Executor changes a quest exactly as the person asked. Write Through MCP writes to an outside tool server only when an allowlist permits it.
